label: ROVER REFERENCE THRESHOLDS - NOT ASTRONAUT LIMITS. Adjustable defaults.

sources.exclude: Verma, V. (2026-10-12), NASA Science blog 'Tracks Along the Longest Drive on Another World': Perseverance tilt limit raised to 24 deg.
sources.warn_and_high_cost: 10/15 deg classes from an academic traversability study (arXiv 2405.12790), citing 15 deg nominal Perseverance limit. 10 deg is that study's own assumption.

limitations: Slope from 20 m DEM is a ~60 m average and underestimates steep faces.
Rover tilt limits are wheel-scale; astronaut EVA limits not sourced.
Class edges: lower bound inclusive. 255 = unknown, never treated as safe.
